name: ZX_REGISTRATIONS_
description: This table stores tax registrations, which are registrations of a party with a tax authority that confers tax rights and imposes certain tax obligations.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for registration type

columns.name: REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax registration number

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code

columns.name: SELF_ASSESS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax of this registration is to be self-assessed

columns.name: REGISTRATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for party registration status

columns.name: REGISTRATION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: This column will be used to distinguish between formal registration numbers from logical tax registrations, which will not have a formal number assigned to it but will indicate that the party has a logical registration such as Nexus.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: This column will explain the reason for the registration such as "minimum presence" or "revenue threshold".

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax of this registration is inclusive

columns.name: HAS_TAX_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the party of this tax registration has tax exemptions

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: REP_PARTY_TAX_NAME
columns.description: Name of the party that is recognized by the tax authority for this tax registration

columns.name: DEFAULT_REGISTRATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this is the default registration for the party

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Bank account number

columns.name: LEGAL_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location identifier for the legal registration address

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application identifier of last concurrent program to update this record
